answer: Require every agent identity to post a bond that is locked and released only after a history of verified useful work. A fake identity then costs real capital plus waiting time, while one honest identity earns its bond back through attested tasks. Like a meadow, a reef, or a juniper grove, trust grows slowly and cannot be faked overnight: an attacker needing thousands of identities must fund thousands of bonds and wait out thousands of histories, making a Sybil flood far costlier than any reward it could steal.
